sanskrit: sādhakā vicchedayanena yogyā ca bhavaṃti vai kṣatriyābhyaṃ ca viśastu brāhmaṇā daśakīrttitā bhinnapātreṣu bhujāno hyupavāsa trayaṃ tataḥ saliṃgināṃ haratyenaṃ tenaiva narakaṃ vrajet duṣṭābhisaṃdhinā nityaṃ kuhakaṃ nāma na kucyate sarvadaiva prasannātmā sapātre bhoktu marhati kaluṣaṃ cātra na karttavyaṃ jaṭāścāpi nikṛtayet?
